axes: +Y up, +Z front; Blender authored +Z up and -Y front; export_yup=True

geometry.method: Round5 sealed body and recessed channel; retained round5 grille with one shallow dent and 1.2 mm lateral bend; 12 mm chamfered tapered end caps, thin bolted end flange and ceiling flanges

material.field_method: True sharp-edge distance sampled from mesh; nonperiodic hashed 3D smooth-value noise only modulates edge chips; fastener-distance heads and vertical Gaussian tails; channel-confined soot; normal-driven upper dust

lit_capture_contrast.control_keeps: Same geometry, glass emission, lighting, camera, seed and samples; clean metal albedo and ORM
lit_capture_contrast.control_disables: Edge chips, oxide, rivet streaks, channel soot, upper dust and paint aging

lit_feature_measurements.note: Effect-isolating lit pairs with identical geometry, lighting and ORM; feature masks rendered from matching cameras.

visible_broad_paint_coverage.method: Body and end/rail hardware only; excludes intentionally dark recessed grille. Olive-preserving material: rust <20%, soot <20%, bare-metal wear <10%. Projected masks intersect lit chromaticity within 0.04 of clean olive after RGB-sum normalization. This is a material/lighting measurement, not a visual verdict.

blockiness_and_tiling_check.measurement_note: Actual lit weather-on/off pair. Raw correlations include physical grille repetition and broad darkening. Broad-face relative effect divides the lit difference by clean-control luminance (floor 0.035), removes a normalized Gaussian sigma-6 px trend, and scans both axes at lags 16..192 px, step 4. Absolute-effect peak is retained separately. Normalization removes illumination scaling without changing material or captures. Correlation statistics do not establish a visual verdict.
blockiness_and_tiling_check.cutoff_note: A correlation maximum alone does not distinguish smooth spatial continuity, physical paired surfaces and periodic image tiling. All maxima and the horizontal secondary-peak prominences are reported without a visual verdict.

slot_lit_measurements.note: Display-referred screen luminance after AgX is distinct from the requested physical emission fraction.

scope: Only tmp/lights-redo/round6 written. Round4, round5 and concepts read-only. No git state changes or foreign process signals. Blender geometry, baking, export and renders; external arrays, sheet assembly and requested trimesh verification.
limitations: No visual inspection or visual quality verdict.
Godot installation and lighting not tested.
Olive-preserving mask measures material composition and retained lit chromaticity, not human perception.
Autocorrelation includes uncertainty from curved mesh shading, sampling and physical repeated geometry.
